verdict.rationale: The SDK's built-in tracing records agent-run events (LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs) and surfaces them in OpenAI's Traces dashboard. It documents a global opt-out via the OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1 environment variable, so the product itself offers a first-party way to turn this collection off. Missing for 10: confirmation that tracing is the only telemetry or usage tracking the SDK performs, documentation of finer-grained or per-run opt-out controls, and independent or hands-on corroboration that disabling it stops all data export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: You can globally disable tracing by setting the env var `OPENAI_AGENTS_DISABLE_TRACING=1`
The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur.
